title: רשות לעצור
emotional_truth: rest is not giving up; choosing to stop is its own kind of courage

forbidden: framing rest as laziness or failure
pushing through exhaustion as a virtue
safety.notes: All levels are gentle and costless. 'Brave' here means allowing yourself to stop, never abandoning a real responsibility to another person. Success is the attempt to actually rest, never how productive the day was.
